leadText:
The Pokémon Sinnoh Collection is a Region 4 Collector's Pokédex Book DVD set released by in Australia on December 3, 2012 and in New Zealand on December 5, 2012. It contains 22 discs with 189 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4144. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of that take place in Sinnoh. It contains episodes from Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl, Battle Dimension, Galactic Battles, and Sinnoh League Victors.

It contains 22 discs with 189 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE4144. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning.

It contains all of the regular dubbed episodes of that take place in Sinnoh. It contains episodes from Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl, Battle Dimension, Galactic Battles, and Sinnoh League Victors.

==Book==
The discs come in a large book, designed to resemble the Sinnoh Pokédex.

 
At the start of the book, there is a brief description of the main characters, having profiles for , Ash's Pikachu, , , and .
